summary: Accounts Receivable module — Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (100%) covering all 7 AR endpoints + auto-AR-creation on sale with debt + payment_method enum 400 validation + plan validation 400. Frontend: smoke E2E via Playwright — sidebar 'Cuentas por cobrar' nav works, /dashboard/cuentas renders with feature-gate accounts_receivable, all 3 tabs (Cuentas/Cuotas/Antigüedad) load and render their data correctly. Cuotas tab shows 4 pending installments with patient names + days_to_due + traffic light. Antigüedad shows all 5 buckets with correct totals (Al día Q200=24.4%, d31_60 Q620=75.6%, total Q820 across 2 cuentas activas). End-to-end auto-AR-creation verified: created sale Q500 with Q200 cash → AR row auto-created with original_amount=500, paid_amount=200, balance=300, status=pending, due_date=+30d. Then registered Q100 abono → balance=200, status=partial, sale.amount_due synced to 200, sale.amount_paid=300, sale.payment_status=partial. Then created plan 3 monthly cuotas → installments_list returns 3 rows summing exactly to balance Q200, all status=pending. Listed via /installments — 3 new + existing 4 returned with patient_name + days_to_due.

minor.issue: On exception returns generic 500 with detail='Error' (line 4683) — same pattern across all AR endpoints. Loses root cause for debugging in prod. Recommend logging + returning structured error message.
N+1 query pattern: for each installment fetches AR + patient row separately. For clinics with many installments this is slow. Recommend a single Postgres view/RPC with join.
Frequency='monthly' uses fixed timedelta(days=30) instead of true calendar months — drifts ~5d/year. Also no upper bound on installments (could request 1000+ and DDOS DB).

Non-transactional: deletes existing installments (line 4762) BEFORE inserting new ones in a loop — if any insert fails mid-loop, AR is left with partial plan and no rollback. Wrap in a Postgres function or insert all in one batch.
Non-atomic with sale sync: payment row + AR update + sale update are 3 separate calls; if 2nd or 3rd fails the AR could show paid while sale still shows due. Wrap in a Postgres function.

issues: First-due-date input uses native HTML <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar popover (recurring carryover from prior iterations).

action_items: RECOMMEND (LOW): wrap register_ar_payment + sale sync in a Postgres RPC for atomicity (3 sequential writes risk inconsistency on partial failure).
RECOMMEND (LOW): wrap create_payment_plan (delete-then-insert-loop) in a Postgres RPC; cap installments<=60 to prevent abuse.
RECOMMEND (LOW): replace fixed timedelta(days=30) with relativedelta(months=1) for true monthly frequency.
RECOMMEND (LOW): replace native <input type='date'> in CreatePlanDialog (line 375 AccountsReceivablePage.js) with shadcn Calendar popover for consistency with the rest of the app.
RECOMMEND (LOW): collapse N+1 query in /installments by using a single SQL view with patients join (or PostgREST embed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4804 lines — AR endpoints (lines 4521-4782) should be extracted to /app/backend/routers/accounts_receivable.py.
All AR endpoints catch broad Exception and return HTTPException(500, 'Error') — loses debugging info; at minimum include str(e) in non-prod or log a request_id.
register_ar_payment + create_payment_plan are not idempotent and have no transaction wrapper — Supabase Python client doesn't support transactions natively; consider Postgres RPC functions.
list_pending_installments has N+1 (per-installment AR + patient lookup) — same pattern as list_sales noted in iteration_13.
